feats.title: Wholesome Spirit
feats.description: Your spirit companion receives the same necrotic and radiant resistance as your Astral Resistance trait.
feats.note: The index says Heroic, but the entry body labels Wholesome Spirit Paragon.

feats.title: Commander's Memory
feats.description: As a free action, expend Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes to add 1d6 to an ally's attack roll, saving throw, or skill check within 10 squares.
